With every level, new challenges appear—packed parking lots, tricky buses, and colorful traffic jams waiting for your brainpower. Easy to play, hard to master, and endlessly entertaining.

title: Desert Rover Survival
description: Desert Rover Survival is an idle survival adventure set in a harsh desert world. Begin with a simple setup and slowly build your own desert rover, upgrading parts and improving technology to push farther into the wasteland.

title: Popping Sushi
description:
Drop adorable sushi pieces into the field and watch them merge!
When two identical pieces touch, they combine into a bigger, tastier creation.
Aim for the ultimate sushi roll and claim the top spot on the global leaderboard!

title: Dog Merge Mania
description: Merge cute puppies! Unlock breeds & grow your own fluffy dog paradise! A Relaxing Escape: The perfect mix of chill gameplay and light strategy.

title: Cubes 2048.io
description: Begin an exciting .io battle where Snake meets 2048 in a nervous arcade showdown. Control your cube snake, collect, merge, and grow bigger while outsmarting opponents in this classic action-puzzle game. Control your snake to navigate around the map. Collect more cubes and merge the same numbers to reach 2048. Match the same number to make it bigger.

title: Mojicon Garden JigSolitaire
description: Piece together a paradise in Mojicon Garden Jigsaw Solitaire! Solve beautiful puzzles to restore a dry meadow back to a lush, blooming garden. Enjoy a meditative experience with smooth controls and the iconic Mojicon art style. Can you bring the garden back to life?

title: Sudoku Garden
description: Players must expand their thinking to solve puzzles in adventures. Learn to approach problems from different angles and discover hidden clues and patterns to overcome challenges. These games test wit while fueling interest and challenge-seeking mentality.

title: Sum Master
description: Sum Master is an engaging and challenging number puzzle game designed to enhance your mental arithmetic and logical reasoning skills. The objective is to select numbers within a grid so that the sums of each row, column, and colored region match the specified targets. Each puzzle has a unique solution, requiring players to carefully consider which numbers to include or exclude. The game offers a stimulating experience that combines fun with educational value.

title: Soo Match: Room Design
description: Soo Match! is a fun and engaging blast game. Players progress by tapping and matching blocks of the same color to complete levels. At the end of each level, tickets can be used to complete rooms and unlock new stages, while in-game coins can be spent to acquire new characters. With its charming graphics and diverse game modes, Soo Match! offers a dynamic and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop
description:
"Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop" – A Charming Puzzle Game About Merging Jelly Dolls!

In this addictive game, you'll drop adorable Labubu dolls, match identical ones, and create new characters! When two matching Labubus collide, they transform into the next doll in your collection. Earn coins for every merge, then spend them to operate the claw machine – fish out exactly the Labubu you need to complete each level!

Can you collect all the Labubus?

title: Race It: Car Racing
description: Play Race It: Car Racing free online and jump into a high-speed browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Challenge rivals in intense 1v1 city races, swipe to drift, time your boosts, and outsmart opponents in a skill-based brain game of reflex and control. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for quick breaks and nonstop racing action.

title: Russian Fishing at Sea
Snap Fix
description:
Snap Fix is a fast-paced block puzzle game where you slide tiles to restore a scrambled picture.
With one empty space to maneuver, you must think quickly and arrange the grid before time runs out!
Complete the puzzle to unlock and download the image as a reward.
Can you snap everything into place before the clock hits zero?

title: Gas Station - Stick Simulator
description: You start with a small gas station in the middle of the highway, where everything depends on you. Service cars, fill up with gas, earn coins, and build even bigger! Over time, your gas station will grow into a true empire: with a store, restroom, cafe, and even a hot dog delivery service. The more customers, the more profit, upgrades, and fun!

title: Pool Merge
description:
This is an arcade puzzle with billiard physics and 2048 merge mechanics. Shoot balls, combine identical ones and score points!
Game modes:
Classic: plan your moves, avoid overflowing the field. With each new open ball level, the limit of allowed balls on the playing field increases.
Arcade: play for time, do not let the balls fall into the holes. Merging balls adds time to the timer, balls that fall into the holes take time away.

title: Last Ufo Defense
description:
Last UFO DefenseThe galaxy is no safe place. 
As the last UFO of your kind, you stand alone against endless waves of hostile alien forces determined to wipe you out.
Pilot your hovering warship and unleash its full potential:One UFO, endless enemies. 
Survive as long as you can with precise upgrades and tactical choices.
Face relentless alien swarms in an endless survival challenge.You are the final line of defense in a hostile galaxy.
How long can the last UFO endure?

title: My Cake Shop: Bake & Serve
description: Run your own sweet bakery in My Cake Shop! Bake and stack colorful donuts, clean messy floors, and serve hungry customers. Expand across the world by unlocking new bakery locations and upgrading machines. Manage crowds, grow your patisserie empire, and become the ultimate idle arcade tycoon!

title: HomeRun Derby
description: Step up to the plate and experience the excitement of Baseball's exhilarating Home Run Derby! Swing your bat and aim for the fences to hit as many home runs as you can. Time your swings carefully to score big points and keep the crowd cheering! How many home runs can you hit in a row? Test your skills and see if you can become the ultimate Home Run champion!

title: Pixel Destroyer
description:
Pixel Destroyer is an exciting physics-based arcade puzzle game where your goal is to destroy colorful pixel shapes using bouncing balls.

Dive into a world of pixel destruction! In this game, you’ll need to use your wits and precision. Each level features a unique shape made of pixel blocks. Your objective is to destroy them all using a limited number of shots. The balls follow the laws of physics, bouncing off walls and obstacles, allowing you to reach even the most hard-to-access blocks.

title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
description: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a soothing thread-sorting challenge that blends creativity with logic. Organize colorful yarns across tricky boards, using boosters like the Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom when levels get tough. Customize your setup with extra slots and boxes, and enjoy calm, vibrant visuals. With progressively harder puzzles, it’s both relaxing and rewarding for sorting and puzzle fans alike.

title: Bbq Stack Run
description: Enter a running arcade adventure filled with food and fun challenges. BBQ Stack Run takes you through the craziest BBQ-collecting parkour ever. Pick up various ingredients such as beef, chicken, sausage and more on the track as you run. Sprinkle them with barbecue seasoning and cook them through.

title: Kingdom match
description: Kingdom match is a competitive match-3 game with castle decoration options! Complete levels, compete with other players and build the best castle!

title: Car Vs Zombies
description:
Car vs Zombie is a fast-paced low-poly survival game where you smash through endless zombie waves with your car, build turrets, and defend your base from the undead horde! 
Get ready for non-stop action in Car vs Zombie, a low-poly, cartoony survival game where chaos meets fun!
Will you survive the apocalypse — or become zombie food?

title: Draw Climber
description:
Funniest race you ever played ! Draw your legs to win the race!
Any drawing will make you run !
When you are stuck you can draw another shape to pass!

title: Draw To Fly
description: Ready for a game that’s as creative as it is challenging? Draw Fly brings your imagination to life, turning simple drawings into pathways to solve puzzles and conquer obstacles. Whether you’re flying past traps or dodging tricky obstacles, this puzzle game will keep you entertained for hours.

title: Vex X3M 3
description: VEX X3M 3 is here! The most intense Vex hill racing experience yet. Race through new levels filled with traps, sand, electricity, and unpredictable terrain that test your timing and skill. Ride through pipes, master new physics, and take on hard mode or a CPU opponent. Unlock powerful bikes, beat every track, and prove you’re a true VEX X3M rider. Start your engine and take on the challenge!

title: Supermarket Shopping For Kids
description: Have you ever dreamed of owning your own supermarket? In this casual supermarket simulator game, you can make your dream come true! In our Supermarket Shopping For Kids game, you can not only enjoy shopping but also play as a cashier and check out items! Apart from that, there are also many fun mini-games you can join in the supermarket.

title: Worm: Apple Quest
description:
Get Ready for Challenging Puzzles in Worm: Apple Quest!

In this captivating puzzle platformer, guide your worm to the legendary Golden Apple while navigating devious obstacles and perilous chasms. The secret to success? Mastering your worm's growing length.

Every apple you collect makes your worm longer, unlocking new paths - but beware! With greater length comes tougher control. One wrong turn and you might get stuck, ending your run.

title: Cake Merge
description: Cake Merge is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you build whole cakes from colorful slices. Clear the tray, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and unlock new desserts as you play. With smooth animations, cute visuals, and easy-to-learn gameplay, Cake Merge is perfect for fans of casual merge, sorting, and matching games. Earn points, level up, and enjoy the sweetest merges!

title: SHOT CAN WILD
description: Keep tapping to shoot and prevent the can from falling! The game ends when you run out of ammo. Hit the center of te target for a COOL SHOT! Chain COOL SHOT to restore ammo!

This is a casual game of shooting balloons with darts.

When all the darts are pulled out, the board will also fall. When all the boards fall, the game is won.

The game is easy and simple to play, and the difficulty is getting stronger and stronger, which is challenging

With clean visuals, smooth controls, and hundreds of words to discover.

title: Fruite Swipe
description:
Get ready for a juicy adventure with Fruit Swipe Match, Swipe and match colorful fruits to solve exciting puzzles and unlock fantastic rewards. With hundreds of challenging levels, stunning graphics, and smooth gameplay, this match-3 game will keep you entertained for hours.

Compete with friends, discover hidden treasures, and master fun power-ups. Download Fruit Swipe Match now and experience the ultimate fruit-matching fun. It's time to swipe, match, and win big!

title: Snake Go - Escape Puzzle
description: Your goal is simple: guide the snake through tangled grids and help it escape without getting stuck. Each level challenges you to think ahead, choose the right order, and find safe paths through tight spaces. Blending classic snake mechanics with modern puzzle escape logic, every maze feels handcrafted — clean, clever, and satisfying to solve.

title: Superhero Escape Run – Parkour Challenge!
description:
Jump, Dash & Escape in the Ultimate Superhero Parkour Adventure!

Get ready for a thrilling parkour escape challenge! Take control of 4 unique superhero characters, each on a daring mission to break free from intense environments. Run, jump, and dodge deadly traps and impossible obstacles in this fast-paced action platformer!

Timing is everything. One wrong move, and it’s game over. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate parkour escape hero?

title: Park Me: Draw Path
description: "Park Me: Draw Path" is a casual puzzle game integrating "painting + parking + puzzle solving", which adds "drawing lines" to the traditional parking gameplay, testing the player's logical thinking, spatial imagination and path planning ability, and getting an "intellectual exercise" in a short period of time.

title: Nuts & Bolts Sort: Color Puzzle
description: Play Color Sort Puzzle: Nuts & Bolts free online and challenge your mind in a clever browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Unscrew, swap, and organize bolts by color in a satisfying logic puzzle that works as a focused brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart, addictive sorting fun anytime.

description:
Your goal in each level is to reach the Goal Platform. Levels are played in two phases.

Duration: Short preview at the start of each level

•	Study the layout, paths, traps, and pickups.

•	All memory phase platforms become invisible unless they are marked to stay visible.

title: Water Sort Puzzle 3

If you combine the same items, a higher level of items will be created.
Make legendary items and become the best blacksmith.

Mahjong matching game!

Please remove the last block!

Collect the buildings and create a cool city!

Is a massive online world where three unique modes are waiting for you!

Take on the challenge of 100 levels of hard obby, compete in crazy races with 5 players, and test your fate on a glass bridge in the spirit of Squid Game!

Create your unique character by choosing from over 100 cool skins!

Team up with friends using a code in squads of up to 3 people and conquer all modes together!

Ready to show off your agility and strategy? Set records and become a legend!

title: 2 Player Battle
description: Seeking an exciting way to spend time with friends and family is most significant. Look no further than Party Battle, the ultimate 2-4 player game! With 30 different games, this exciting collection has something for everyone.

In this game, you will command squads of melee fighters and ranged archers fighting against waves of enemies. Your agility and strategic thinking will give you an edge to victory.

Unlock new powerful fighters and accurate archers by combining those available for purchase. Place them on the map according to abilities and win.

title: Hook Pin Jam
description: Hook Jam is an addictive puzzle game where you untangle and release hooks to clear the board and earn rewards. Each level challenges your logic and planning with increasingly complex layouts. Solve puzzles efficiently, unlock new stages, and test your problem-solving skills in this clever, satisfying brain game.

title: Parkour Block 7

Skill game, classic mode from your favorite games right in the browser on your computer and phone!

title: Mr Long Legs
description: Get ready to wobble, stretch, and stumble with Mr. Long Legs, the funniest physics puzzle game you’ll ever play! Step into the shoes of a long-legged stickman hero and control his stretchy legs to cross impossible terrains.

title: People Playground! Ragdoll Arena!
description:
People Playground! Ragdoll Arena! is a fun physics-based adventure where chaos is the goal. Tap and hold objects to move them, then release to throw them at the doll.

Your goal:
Inflict maximum damage and destroy your doll using everything at your disposal. Drop a car on his head, throw a rock at him, or throw him off a cliff. Every action triggers a reaction, so experiment with different ways to destroy. Sometimes there will be multiple dolls: twice the targets, twice the strategies!

title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
description: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a creative and exciting puzzle game that combines drawing and rescue gameplay into one addictive experience. You become a bridge designer, using your finger to draw safe paths and complete thrilling rescue missions. Enter the car mode, draw a strong bridge to help a motor cross gaps, broken roads, and dangerous obstacles to reach the goal.

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: Match Dream Garden
description: What a beautiful garden! Match leaves, flowers, apples and other items to progress. Use power-ups like the Hammer to remove any piece, the Rake to clear an entire row or column, or the Gardening Gloves to swap two pieces.

title: THE KULKA
description:
THE KULKA is a one-button bullet-heaven arcade game where your single shot evolves into chaos. Inspired by Flappy Birds, Vampire Survivor and Pattern Survivors: Bullet Hell. 

MUTATE YOUR BULLET. FLAP, EVOLVE, SURVIVE.

title: Snow Rider Obby Parkour
description:
Snow Rider Obby Parkour is a fast-paced snowboard adventure where reflexes, timing, and control matter. Play solo or with a friend in split-screen mode and experience different snow challenges across multiple game modes. Whether you want to beat distance records, explore a massive open world, or race down dangerous mountains, this game offers a complete snowboarding experience.

Master your snowboard, perform double jumps, and unlock amazing gear to customize your character!

title: Xmas Hexa Sort
description:
Xmas Hexa Sort is a festive twist on the classic hexagon puzzle!
Move and place colorful stacks of blocks on the board to create perfect combinations and clear space. Relax, think ahead, and enjoy the cozy holiday atmosphere as you solve each cheerful puzzle!

title: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up
description:
In Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up, you’re dressing up your doll and getting her ready to go live. Pick from different styles—she can look like a fairy, wear chill street clothes, or go for a beach outfit. When you’re done, she jumps on the stream and starts showing off her look.

You can mess with her hair, add makeup, and try out accessories. There’s also a battle mode where you go up against other players to see who styled it best.

title: Arrow Count Master
description: Arrow Count Master is a fast and satisfying runner where every choice changes your firepower. Swipe to move and choose between gates that add, subtract, multiply, or boost your arrows. Build the biggest arrow count possible while avoiding penalties and obstacles along the way.

title: Paint Master
description: Fill the squares to match the sample pattern. Tap the brush to paint a straight line of squares in one move. When your moves reach zero the game is over, so use them carefully to clear the stage!

title: Labubu Pop
description:
Labubu Pop is a bright and cheerful puzzle game where the playful Labubus have completely taken over the box! Connect matching characters into chains, clear the board, and earn points to level up. Each stage brings fun surprises, and even more exciting combos!

With its colorful visuals, smooth animations, and simple yet addictive gameplay, Labubu Pop is perfect for relaxing and having fun anytime. The longer your chain — the higher your score and the flashier the effects!

title: Hit Knock Down
description: Hit & Knock Down is a fun casual game where you aim to throw baseballs. Shoot as many targets as possible. Test your precision, reaction speed, and throwing skills. You aim to hit the right targets in each level. The goals at the level are very varied, such as wood, stone, etc. Each level presents different targets. You should hit with a baseball.

title: Bento Match
description:
Slide the blocks to line them up straight and clear them!
If there’s space, you can move multiple blocks at once.
You can also move blocks without clearing them, but you’ll lose 1 life.
Earn coins based on your score and use them to collect new blocks!
Collected blocks will appear randomly in the game—rare blocks give higher scores!

title: Shine Seek
description: Dive into Gem Hunt Adventure, a fun treasure hunt puzzle game where you shine, seek, and solve! Explore glowing worlds, collect gems, and unlock hidden treasures while testing your brain with logic challenges. Perfect for US students searching “hidden object games,” “find the difference,” or “treasure hunt game.” With starry puzzles, bright visuals, and endless fun, this addictive casual game is the ultimate light-seeking adventure!

title: Find the Frog - Hidden Objects
description: Go on a relaxing and magical adventure in Find the Frog - Hidden Objects. In this charming hidden object game, you’ll explore beautifully hand-drawn black-and-white scenes and try to spot frogs hiding in plain sight. With each click or tap, the world around you lights up in color, revealing hidden surprises and playful details. Play for free on both mobile and desktop, unlock new levels, and collect unique frogs from all around the world.

title: Arrow Wave
description: Explore a world where a wave moves through various obstacles, overcoming challenges along the way. Test your reaction and perseverance!

title: Room Sort Floor Plan
description: Room Sort Floor Plan is a fun creative puzzle game with elements of sorting and design. In this casual game, you’ll go through proper sorting and organization. Designing the perfect layout for every room. Rearrange the floor plan to create your unique home. Each level is a jigsaw puzzle challenge.

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Your favorite pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to save them and punish the alien bullies. Evolve to defeat stronger enemies, free new dogs, get unique resources so that your dogs can evolve! Collect all the dog breeds and see how cool they will be! Discover new territories, visit the beach, park, city square and forest!

title: Hero Rabbit Idle Survivor RPG
description: We are rabbits! A fun offline survival shooting RPG game starring a rabbit!Hero Rabbit is an offline game. Players can play games anytime, anywhere without connecting to WiFi and the Internet.

title: Sword and Jewel
description: Sword and Jewel is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game where you place colorful gems on the board to create lines of three or more. Match gems in rows or columns to clear them, score points, and keep the board from filling up. Plan your moves carefully - when there’s no space left for new gems, the game ends!

title: Steal Brainrot Original 3D
description: Buy rare animals—from the entry-level Nubini Pitzanini to Tralalelo Tralal and Los Tralaleritos. Place them in your base, create ideal conditions, and start earning! Each animal generates income ? and opens the door to new opportunities. Grow your collection, improve your infrastructure, experiment with your team composition, and increase your profits. Want more income? Buy new, rarer animals and build your financial empire.

title: Galactic Golf Solitaire
description:
Enjoy a relaxing round of Golf Solitaire, a fun and easy-to-play card game. The goal is to clear the board by matching cards that are one rank higher or lower than the one on the discard pile. Don’t worry about suits—just focus on the numbers! If you’re stuck, you can draw from the deck to keep the game going. Play at your own pace and see how many rounds you can win.

Perfect for a quick break or to unwind at the end of the day!

title: Winter Tetrix Trails
description:
Winter Tetrix Trails is a relaxing shape-filling puzzle game set in a snowy world.
Drag and place colorful Tetris-style blocks to complete each unique silhouette — think carefully, fit perfectly, and enjoy the magic of winter puzzles!

title: Ballerina Cappuccina First Date
description: Tonight’s a big night—Cappuccina and Tung Tung Sahur are heading out on their very first date, and they want to look perfect. In Ballerina Cappuccina First Date, you’re the stylist behind their special evening. From choosing outfits to adding finishing touches, it’s up to you to make sure both of them shine.

title: MineBlocks 3D Maze
description: MineBlocks 3D Maze: A Mind-Bending Adventure in a Blocky World! Get ready to step into a world of puzzles and creativity with MineBlocks 3D Maze—an incredible game that’s perfect for kids and adults alike. If you’re a fan of brain-teasers and enjoy a good challenge, this 3D puzzle game is exactly what you need. It’s all about strategy, logic, and a little bit of muscle (virtual, of course)!  Push the blocks strategically to guide them onto the altars scattered across the level.

title: Dynamons 12
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 12! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Guardian Tomb world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons Captain Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon trainer. Encounter the 8 titans from the Guardian King: Bearmoryx, Sharkonyx, Crocynos, Horzaryx, Visi, Rhinodys, Fenixaro, Uryndur and many more special Dynamons.

title: Bubble Shooter Legend

Make them explode and disappear to complete each level step by step. Match three or more bubbles of the same color by aiming and firing them to explode and eliminate them!

title: Real Street Fighter 3D
description: Real Street Fighter 3D have very addictive game-play and many missions. In this you have to fight with other enemies and have to complete mission. It has many addictive missions.

title: The Sorting Mart
description: The Sorting Mart is a store sorting puzzle game that lets you experience the fun of shopping in a store. Rearrange items between shelves to match three identical ones on a shelf, clearing it and letting the upper shelves drop down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves and keep matching before time runs out. If you get stuck, use the shuffle button to mix up the shelves and find matches more easily. Challenge your sorting skills as levels become more difficult!

title: Pentaword
description: Guess the hidden five-letter word in just six tries! Use logic, spelling, and word skills in this brain teaser. Can you crack the Pentaword?

title: Obby Rescue Pin
description:
Obby Rescue Pin is a brain-burning, high IQ puzzle game that is especially addictive. How you pull the pins to rescue the Obby depends entirely on your logic and strategy!
Avoid Dangers: Navigate around bombs, ferocious animals, and deadly traps.

Your task is to play as a Stickman and find all the ways to successfully escape from prison. 10 different items to choose from are hidden in a secret place. Some items will lead you to victory, but many other items will lead you to death. Interesting animations and jokes will delight your attention. Check out all the items and enjoy the different situations in the zone.

title: Dino Egg Shooter
description:
Dino Egg Shooter is a fun and addictive puzzle game set in a colorful prehistoric world.
With 100 levels of increasing difficulty, players aim and shoot colorful dino eggs to clear the board. 
Each level presents unique challenges, from tricky formations to limited shots.
Easy controls and charming visuals make Dino Egg Shooter perfect for all ages.
So, get ready

Challenge your brain with this addictive number puzzle. Plan your moves carefully, build combos, and aim for the highest score. How far can you go beyond 2048?

title: Soccer Tournament
description: Soccer Tournament is a fun and fast-paced tabletop-style soccer game where you control a team of caps, flicking them to pass, shoot, and score goals. Strategize your moves, outplay your opponent, and aim for victory in this exciting, skill-based challenge!

title: Blocks Stack Rush
description: Enjoy an addictive stacking adventure. In Blocks Stack Rush, you’ll control a little block character running and begin a fun pixelated journey. Collect blocks, stack them high and race against time to build the perfect picture. You need to align each block and keep putting together the complete picture.

title: Block Up
description: Block Up Contrast is a minimalist arcade game where you need a moving block upward through an endless series of obstacles. The challenge is to avoid barriers of contrasting colors while collecting points. The game requires precise timing and quick reflexes as the speed increases. With simple yet engaging gameplay, Block Up Contrast offers an addictive experience for players.

title: Geometry Vibes 3D
description: Geometry Vibes 3D takes everything you loved about the original Geometry Vibes and brings it into a vibrant, dynamic 3D world. With fully reimagined levels and stunning new visuals, this version elevates your reflexes and rhythm-based skills to new dimensions.

title: Cheerful Plumber
description: Greetings, young artist. Do you like video games and creativity? Then this game is for you! Color video game characters: a princess, a cheerful plumber, a dragon and others! Choose different colors on the main and secondary palette. Play and color! Take a screenshot and share the result with your friends!

Browse through a vast collection of colorful ballerina and glam outfits, chic accessories, and shoes. Glide, twirl, and experience the fun-filled, fashion-centric icy adventure with this engaging dress-up game for girls.

title: Elite Chess
description: Enjoy classic gameplay with three chess modes, each offering varying time settings suited to your play style. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond, and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Boxteria
description:
Dive into an amazing cubic world, where you can become anyone from a BANDIT to a ZOMBIE attacking everyone around! Imagine having 20 super cool cars at your disposal to ride, drift, and have fun on maps like "Russian Village," and "Courtyard," spaces filled with adventures.

You'll enjoy creating characters, each unique in their own way. You can assemble a team of bandits, zombies, or even police officers and engage in thrilling battles or cool races.

title: Echolocation Shooter
description:
Shoot to see in the dark!

Eliminate all the neon enemies, in the horroristic level!

The only way to see in this FPS is to generate soundwave with your weapon.

Survive endless waves of the wide variety of enemies, where the only way to see is to shoot. Unleash soundwave rifles, laser cannons, and grenades to light up the battlefield, upgrade your gear, and fight deeper into the horde.

Every shot reveals the world—every wave pushes your limits.

title: Jump to the Mountain for the Brainrots
description:
You'll play as Obby, a character located on a tall mountain.
Various Brainrots will randomly appear on the mountain, guarded by enemies.
Your task is to jump up the mountain and rescue the Brainrots. Collect the entire Brainrot collection without falling into enemy hands!
Sell Brainrots to increase your jump height and reach the very top of the mountain. Rare Brainrot species live at the very top.

title: Pixel Mini Golf
description:
Mini Golf is a complete game, with 400 different levels, and an addictive system. Have fun exploring the game’s green hills and plains while listening to the birds and enjoying its beautiful views, collect as many coins as possible and try to hit all the holes to achieve the highest score.

Among the game mechanics are levels with: Portals, Boxing Gloves, Cannons, Burners, Impulses, Mill, Sand, Mole Holes, Spikes and Movement Blocks that will help or hinder your game!

title: Hero Merge
description:
Hero Merge is an exciting tower defense game where strategy and firepower combine! Merge your heroes to create stronger units, strategically position them on grid, and defend your wall against waves of different enemies. Unlimited waves, plenty of perks and many different units!

Will your heroes stand strong, or will the enemies break through?

title: RPG Idle Clicker
description: Join the adventure in RPG Idle Clicker, a thrilling idle RPG where you slay monsters with a single tap! Click to deal damage, earn gold, and unlock powerful swords to boost your clicks. Upgrade your blades and recruit auto-attacking heroes who fight monsters every second, even offline. With stunning visuals, face tougher foes and epic bosses in this browser-based game. Perfect for active players or idle fans, RPG Idle Clicker offers endless progression!

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker is your ultimate creative escape into the world of anime character design. Craft stunning anime couples with romantic flair, dress up stylish girl avatars, and mix and match accessories, hairstyles, and outfits. With relaxing ASMR touches and a vibrant anime art style, this avatar creator lets your imagination shine in every love-filled duo you design.

title: Office Spider Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Spider Solitaire is to clear the table by creating suited sets from king to ace. The game has either one, two or four suits depending on the difficulty setting.

title: Snake King
description: Get ready to slither your way to the top in this addictive take on the classic Snake game! As the Snake King, you’ll navigate through a maze-like arena, avoiding collisions with the four walls and your own tail.

title: Billiard Diamond Challenge
description: Billiard Diamond Challenge is a fun and free online billiard game for both kids and adults. Your goal is to sink all the balls into the pockets except for the white ball. While playing, you can collect blue diamonds that allow you to unlock a brand new cue. The game offers both level mode and time mode, so you can choose the challenge that suits you best. Get ready to test your skills and have fun at the billiard table!

title: Lovie Chic's Coachella Festival
description: Step into the vibrant world of Lovie Chic’s Coachella Festival, the ultimate festival dress-up game! Style your character with trendy outfits, accessories, and makeup to shine at the iconic Coachella Festival. With simple controls and endless creativity, Lovie Chic’s Coachella Festival is perfect for quick fun or long gaming sessions.

title: Frog.io
description: Frog io is a 2D PvP game where players control frogs battling for dominance. Use your frog's tongue to devour other players and grow bigger and stronger! As you explore the map, eat fruits and enemy frogs to boost your size and power. But beware other players are after you too! Outsmart them, grow massive, and become the top frog in this dynamic and competitive io game.

title: Animal in Rails!
description:
An exciting puzzle game about delivering animals to a trader's base

Connect and disconnect railways around the world to help each animal reach its home.

Install, remove, and redirect connections so that wagons can safely connect to the locomotive. But be careful and don't let them collide with each other!

Delay trains by using railway barriers. Change the tracks to redirect the wagons in different directions. Pick up new pets along the way and face even more challenges along the way!

title: Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker
description: Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker is a fun and addictive brick-breaking game where a lively cat motivates you with cheerful meows. Your goal is to clear all the bricks without dropping the ball. As you break more bricks, the cat gets even more excited, dancing and playing around. With colorful graphics and dynamic gameplay, this game offers a delightful experience for players of all ages. Stay sharp and keep up!

title: Frost Land - Snow Survival
description: Frost Land - Snow Survival is a strategic base-building game where you battle the harsh cold to stay alive. You’ll wield a flamethrower to melt snow, uncover hidden resources, and expand your shelter. Every choice matters—manage supplies wisely and decide which frozen zones to explore as you carve out survival in a relentless winter.

title: Candy Jewels
description: It is a candy-filled puzzle adventure full of surprises! Match candies, break chests and collect coins as you progress through countless levels. Complete fun events like Time Attack or Coin Catch and use boosters to overcome tricky obstacles even faster!

title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
description: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. It sounds easy: just remove cards from the board one higher or lower than the next card in the deck. But there's a whole other world behind these simple rules! The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks!

title: CloneUp - Stack Yourself
description:
CloneUp – Stack Yourself is a 2D pixel-art platformer where your greatest tool is… yourself!

Create clones, stack them, and use them as platforms to dodge spikes, reach new heights, and make your way to the exit door.

In CloneUp – Stack Yourself, you’ll use copies of the main character to reach platforms and avoid deadly obstacles.

title: Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags
description: Immerse yourself in Flag Jam, a unique blend of puzzle-solving, flags collecting, and visual ASMR effects! Tap to match banner pieces, watch them glide smoothly into place, and clear the board as you complete each flag. With easy-to-learn mechanics and stunning visual effects, Flag Jam is the perfect game to help you unwind.

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: Rooftop Run
description: Run, jump, and slide over rooftops in this fast-paced parkour game! Dodge obstacles, smash through barriers, and escape from enemies as you race through exciting levels.

title: Stick Fight The Chaos
description: Hello young warriors! In Stick Fight The Chaos, the fierce battles between stickmen continue with even more action! Catch the weapons falling from the sky, challenge your opponent and become the champion of the battlefield! Keep your balance, focus on your enemy and keep fighting! Each level brings new surprises. Play alone or with a friend and defeat your opponents!

title: Noob Village Tower Defense
description: Dive into the dynamic world of a 2D platformer, where you play as a noob fighting for the survival of your village! Your main goal is to protect the village from endless waves of monsters appearing from an ominous portal. Control the tower manually: select shells, adjust the trajectory and shoot enemies one by one. Only your accuracy and tactics will help you survive the onslaught!

title: Celebrity Aesthetic Challenge
description: Celebrity Aesthetic Challenge lets you explore a range of unique celebrity-inspired styles! Compete in fun fashion challenges as you mix and match outfits, accessories, and hairstyles to recreate iconic looks. From E-girl and Soft-girl vibes to edgy streetwear and glam red carpet ensembles, showcase your creativity and win the ultimate fashion battle. Can you rise to the challenge and become the trendsetting fashion icon? Let the style showdown begin!

title: Valentine's Day Couple Date
description: Experience the charm of Paris in Valentine's Day Couple Date, an amazing couple dress-up game for girls. Start with a picturesque breakfast and help Ellie glam up. Next, keep their fitness streak alive with a couple's workout as you dress them both in fashionable gym outfits and accessories. Later, style Ellie & Ben for a dreamy rooftop dinner. Choose from trendy clothing, accessories, and chic hairstyles to create the perfect romantic ambiance. Stay tuned for a special surprise from Ben.

title: Student and Teacher
description:
The school is not ready for you!
Broken laptops, chairs in splinters, the dining room is looted!
Revenge is a dish served in the form of chaos!
Forget about the silent protest – only crushing anarchy!
Make your classmates regret it!
The teacher is in a panic!
The head teacher is furious!
The main thing is not to get caught and avenge the setup!

title: Block Puzzle - Frozen Jewel
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: Tsunami Race
description: Have you ever faced the thrill of escaping a giant tsunami? In this action-packed game, you’ll choose from a variety of unique characters and race to stay ahead of your opponents. The game offers three exciting modes: outrun a tsunami in Tsunami Race, dodge flying fruits in Fruit Run, and slide to glory in Water Slides—knocking down opponents and collecting boosters along the way. Only the fastest and most strategic players will emerge as champions!

title: Stickman Punishment
description: When a mysterious radiation blast grants Stickman and his friends superpowers, heartbreak quickly turns into a quest for revenge! Betrayed by his best friend over a girl, Stickman discovers he can morph into any shape imaginable. Now, he’s ready to use his new abilities to create chaos and keep the pair apart. Dive into this action-packed story filled with unique animations, clever payback strategies, and endless creativity!

title: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic
description: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle game where you clear the board by pairing identical tiles. Play a new puzzle every day, unlock missed days with ads, and keep your weekly streak for exciting rewards! Track your progress in the Weekly Record, where you can challenge yourself to beat your All-Time Best Score. Enjoy smooth gameplay, balanced difficulty from easy to hard, and use helpful boosters like Hint, Shuffle, and Undo to master every layout.

title: Hide And Seek Horror Escape
description: Hide And Seek: Horror Escape is an asymmetric horror escape game. Abandoned schools and haunted hospitals, here's a lot of hidden secrets and treasures are waiting to be discovered. During the game, there are two identities for you to choose, hide or seek?

title: Atomic Merge 2048
description:
Atomic Merge 2048 is a fast-paced puzzle game where you drop and combine numbered blocks to reach the legendary 2048 tile! Strategically  drop blocks which fall on to center , merge identical numbers, and keep the pile from touching the red orbit. Watch out — one wrong drop could be the end!
Perfect for fans of casual, merge, and puzzle games. How high can you score before the stack overflows?

title: Special Holiday Solitaire
description:
Step into a festive world of fun with Special Holiday Solitaire! This cheerful card game combines classic solitaire gameplay with a holiday twist, creating the perfect escape for players of all ages.  
Whether you're looking for a relaxing break or a way to get into the holiday spirit, *Special Holiday Solitaire* is the perfect companion for the season. Challenge yourself, enjoy the magic of the holidays, and spread the festive cheer!

title: Madness Cars Destroy
description:
The game features 6 unique modes:

Funnel: Push cars into the abyss as the funnel narrows!
Rotating Cube: Stay on the spinning cube, which speeds up over time!
Deadly Arena: Dodge falling bombs and collapsing floors—or shoot players instead!
Right Color: Inspired by Roblox, but with cars!
Deadly Bouncers: Avoid spinning mines in a gladiator-style arena!
Hot Potato: Pass the bomb or explode!
Choose from foreign or Russian cars and dive into the action!

title: Ellie and Friends Venice Carnival
description: Step into the glamorous world of Venice Carnival Dressup with Ellie and Friends Venice Carnival, where you can join Ellie and her friends at one of the most extravagant events of the year. The Venice Carnival is all about stunning masks, luxurious costumes, and endless glamour, and now you get to help Ellie and her friends get ready for the big celebration! Design unique looks and create the perfect carnival style with a variety of costumes, accessories, and masks.

title: Cooking Empire
description: Cooking Empire is not just a cooking game, it’s a real explosion of flavors and speed! Start frying, boiling, baking and serving dishes from all over the world with one click! Are you ready to become a chef the whole world will remember?

title: Strawberry Shortcake BoardGames
description: Visit the BerryWorks cafeteria and play checkers, memory, tic-tac-toe, connecting pairs, and complete jigsaw puzzles with your friends.

title: Cleaning Princess
description: This is an ASMR game for girls. If you like to clean everything, our game is right for you. The game has 5 modes: ear cleaning, heel cleaning, back spa, teeth cleaning, and fan cleaning. You can use different tools to clean and massage your body parts. But it is important to note that each mode has a countdown time and you must choose the right tool to do the cleaning.

title: Chicken Banana Quest
description: Help the Chicken and Banana to solve all puzzle quest and find the play button. Use your skills to solve the puzzles before the lives run out and complete all levels with the less possible clicks

title: Zombie Idle Defense
description: Prepare for a zombie showdown in Zombie Idle Defense! In this exciting idle defense game, you will be the last line of defense against wave after wave of zombie attacks! Build your defenses,upgrade your weapons, put your automatic turrets on fire, and fight off the undead!

title: Bubble Sky
description: Bubble Sky is an ascending Bubble Shooter game that will take you to dizzying heights. Will you be able to reach space? Reach a score of 200000 points to unlock the wheel of fortune and win collectible cards to complete your album!

title: Online Car Destruction Simulator 3D
description: Experience a high-speed realistic car collision simulator! Drive down slopes and crash into specialized obstacles with various vehicles, all featuring authentic physics and a detailed damage system with separating parts.

title: Strategy of war. Tanks and helicopters.
description:
"Strategy of war" is an exciting strategy war game where the player has to control squads of tanks and helicopters, develop his base, choose battle tactics and fight the enemy.

The game offers a wide range of equipment and weapons, a variety of missions and tasks, as well as the opportunity to improve and develop their forces. It is important to properly allocate resources, as well as use tactical techniques to defeat the enemy.

title: Countryside Driving Quest
description: Immerse yourself in Countryside Driving Quest, a dynamic driving game that lets you explore picturesque rural landscapes with a variety of challenges to master. Navigate through charming country roads, test your parking skills in tight spots, and perfect your drifting on winding paths. Designed with realistic physics and stunning visuals, this game brings the peaceful yet thrilling experience of countryside driving right to your screen.

title: Dragon Hunter
description:
Choose your character, roll the dice and go on a fun adventure.
Click on monsters - help the hero survive and defeat the legendary dragons in the clicker RPG Dragon Hunter.
Luck and a strong phone glass will determine the fate of the dragon hunter.

title: Animal Block Pop Puzzle
description: Animal Block Pop Puzzle is a fun puzzle game with cute animal-themed visuals. ??✨ Match 3+ animal-shaped blocks ?? on a grid to clear them and score points. As you progress, the game gets faster and adds new tile colors for a growing challenge. With easy drag-and-drop controls and vibrant graphics, it offers a relaxing yet exciting experience for all ages.

title: Skillful Finger
description: Touch the screen and slide your finger along the glowing line without lifting it. Avoid barriers, stay clear of the edges, and react quickly as the speed increases. Customize your ball and tail, face dynamic obstacles, and enjoy endlessly generated paths that keep every run fast, challenging, and addictive.

title: Sprunki
description: Sprunki Challenge is a fun and character interactive music game where you can develop your rhythm skills. Mix rhythms, sounds and characters to create completely original tracks with instantly interacting characters. Drag-and-drop game mechanics allow for an unlimited number of combinations. This way, you will never get bored and create new rhythms and music every time you play. For the horror theme, you can drag the black button onto the character.

title: Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash
description:
Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash:
Explore a world where a geometric wave rushes through crazy obstacles, overcoming challenges one after another. Rhythm, chaos, and a splash of Italian madness — test your reaction and endurance in this geometric trial!

On different levels, you’ll encounter various Italian Brainrot animals: Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brr Brr Patapim, Lirili Larila.

title: Fairy Wingerella
description: Soar through the skies with Fairy Wingerella in this action-packed arcade adventure! Meet Wingerella, a fearless and ambitious fairy striving to become the most powerful of her kind. Embark on her magical journey, navigating enchanting skies and conquering exciting challenges. With captivating visuals and engaging gameplay, this adventure promises endless fun and excitement!

title: Shipbuilding tycoon
description:
Do you want to become a shipyard manager and build big ships?
Step into the role of a shipyard manager and grow your very own ship empire in this addictive idle game! As you build ships, earn profits, and unlock epic vessels, you’ll expand your factory and boost production efficiency.

title: Jenny's Math Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind with Jenny’s Math Puzzle, a fun and brain-boosting online game where logic meets creativity. Arrange number tiles to solve equations, unlock new puzzles, and sharpen your math skills along the way. Play on your phone or computer — every move counts, and every solution brings you closer to becoming a true math master.

title: Wave Road 3D
description: Wave Road 3D is a fast-paced reflex game that challenges your focus, timing, and precision. You control a sleek arrow gliding through a floating road filled with gears, traps, and collectible gems. Whether you’re chasing high scores in endless mode, conquering 20 handcrafted levels in classic mode, or racing head-to-head with a friend in 2 player mode, Wave Road 3D offers a refreshing and dynamic experience.

title: Mojicon Emoji Connect
description:
A fast, fun twist on classic Onet puzzles!
Get ready to match and relax with Mojicon: Emoji Connect – the cheerful tile-linking puzzle bursting with personality!
Connect identical emoji tiles, clear the board, and enjoy satisfying spark effects with every perfect match.
With hundreds of cute icons, calming backgrounds, and rewarding combos, Mojicon delivers endless relaxing fun for all ages.
Play anywhere, anytime – no downloads, just pure emoji joy!

title: Solitaire Emperor - Secrets of Fate
description:
Enter the magical world of Tarot in this captivating solitaire adventure! Each card tells a story, and every level presents a new puzzle. Meet iconic Tarot characters like the wise Hermit and bold Knight of Swords as they guide your journey.
A dark sorcerer threatens to unravel the Arcana's magic—only you can uncover its secrets, solve riddles, and restore balance. Will your intuition and strategy save this mystical realm?

title: Axe Throw
description:
Ready to test your precision? Welcome to Axe Throw, the ultimate test of aim and timing. The rules are simple, but the challenge is endless. You have one goal: Break the target.

But be careful—the path to victory is rigged with danger. Explosive bombs are moving, and blocking your way. One wrong move, and it's game over!

title: Extreme Real Car Driving 2025
description: This ultimate car racing 3D lets you experience real car driving simulator like highway racing with its realistic car damage, accurate car driving physics and many other features. Car driver may use steering wheel, accelerator meter or buttons to control the car. Enjoy the best car driving simulator game and drag racing game that has an addictive game play with endless fun. Now you can modify your any sports race cars from garage according to your interest.

title: Merge Brainrot
description:
Drop and merge the most cursed Italian Brainrot memes!
From "Trallallero Trallala" to "Tum Tum Tum Saur! and "Boneca Ambalabu", they’re all here.
What final Brainrot will you unlock? Dare to find out!

title: Geometry Open World
description: Geometry Open World is a fast-paced 2D action game where players pilot a ship through perilous obstacles, engage in thrilling battles against diverse enemies, and take on epic boss fights. With a vibrant and dynamic open world, strategic upgrades, and powerful abilities, you can chart your own path to triumph. Will you conquer the challenges, defeat the bosses, and rise to become the ultimate champion in this open-world geometric action adventure?

title: Toilet Time
description: Toilet Time is more than just a puzzle game—it’s a hilarious journey into the quirkiest parts of everyday life. Challenge yourself with toilet-inspired puzzles that combine creativity, wit, and humor.

title: 1945 Air Force Airplane
description: Welcome to the 1945 Air Force: Airplane! Begin intense shooting battles in the sky as you engage in nervous fighting action. Upgrade your plane, defeat enemies, and enter epic aerial battles.Every victory brings you closer to becoming the ultimate air force commander.

title: Merge Car Defense
description:
Prepare to battle wave upon wave of relentless enemies as you skilfully merge and upgrade the defences of your cars.

Build out a roster of cars and use them tactically in order to defeat the enemy, collect coins and be victorious!

title: Quizmania: Trivia game
description: Sharpen your mind across exciting levels. Answer a variety of questions from different topics and use strategic hints to guide your way. As you progress, the difficulty increases, offering a rewarding and challenging experience with every round.

title: Merge the Coins USSR!
description: ● Game in an unusual setting! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where coins fall and are connected if they are the same! Connect as many coins as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Master Blender
description: Becoming the Strongest Bartending Master！Tap the bottle lightly to pour water. Organize the water so that each bottle's water is distributed to the corresponding colored cup!

title: Frost Defense
description:
❄️ Embark on a thrilling journey through a frozen wilderness in Frost Defense, a strategic tower defense game that puts your tactical skills to the test! ??

In this action-packed adventure, you'll take on the role of a lone survivor ?‍♂️ battling against the relentless onslaught of arctic creatures ??‍❄️?.
The enemy is merciless — only your ingenuity and strategic prowess can keep you alive in this harsh frozen world. ⚔️?️

title: Puzzle Blocks Asmr Match
description:
Puzzle Blocks ASMR Match is a block puzzle game that combines classics with innovation. It is different from the block jigsaw games and brick puzzle games you usually play. This game uses a
real physics engine. After the bottom blocks are eliminated, the upper bricks will automatically fall down, which makes the game more difficult. In the game, you cannot rotate the blocks to make
them fit more gaps, which means that you often only have one chance.

title: Fill One Line
description:
Dive into the world of fascinating logic and test your mind in an exciting puzzle! Your task is to draw a line across the entire playing field, filling it completely, but keep in mind: there will be obstacles on the way that you need to bypass.

The game offers many levels, from simple to incredibly difficult, allowing each player to choose a suitable challenge.

title: Horror Forest Bear
description: Imagine an angry bear that has escaped from its cave in the forest. It's very hungry and wants to eat honey. You must help the bear. The bear is starving, and it needs to eat all the honey. You need to be very careful—it's a dark and dangerous forest, full of traps and hunters. The hunters have become much stronger because they can shoot with guns now. You must avoid the hunters. Escape from them, collect all the honey, and return to the bear's cave.

title: Draw Weapon Fight Party
description: In Draw Weapon - Fight Party, you can draw your own weapons. Feel free to write your weapon, but keep an eye on the amount of ink left. Your creativity determines your combat style. Enter the 3D battle arena and fight against other opponents in an action-packed showdown. Draw precisely, craft the ultimate weapon, and crush your opponents to become the ultimate warrior.

title: Survival Sword Battle
description: Survival Sword Battle throws you into a ruthless sword-fighting free-for-all battle where a single hit means defeat. Fight to unlock all 10 character evolutions and boost your speed with each upgrade. Can you dominate the leaderboard and survive the longest?

title: Sword And Spin
description: In Sword and Spin, you’re a brave warrior with a sword, racing through challenging arcade levels filled with obstacles and enemies. Use your sword to cut through everything in your path! Spin around with your greatsword.

title: Parking Master Urban Challenges
description:
A realistic 3D parking simulator where you can hone your driving skills and become a real parking master!
Get behind the wheel of realistic cars of different sizes and maneuver through crowded city streets, parking in the most difficult places.
Pass all the tests, become a parking master and prove that you can do any maneuver!

title: Javelin Battle
description: Javelin Battle is a spear-throwing physics puzzle game with 2D stickman models. We need you to eliminate all incoming enemies at each level in the Normal Mode. When you destroy enemy infantry's shields, they will run to you quickly. I strongly suggest you destroy the enemy spearmen on the platforms first. Don't forget to choose skills to increase your abilities and power. Keep calm and aim carefully.

title: Nubik in the Monster World
description:
Nubik saved the kittens, but the monsters are back! Evil Huggy has kidnapped them again!
Now Nubik has new weapons: AK-47, M16, grenade launcher, machine gun, and shotguns!
Help him rescue the kittens, collect loot, earn coins, upgrade, blast TNT, and escape traps. Even his friend gets captured—help Nubik save him too!

title: NG: Flow Lines
description: Flow Lines is an engaging and straightforward puzzle game where the main objective is to connect dots of the same color through a continuous path on a grid.

title: Flip It 3D
description: In this fun and challenging puzzle platform game, test your strategic thinking as you navigate through levels where flipping platforms is the key to survival! Goblins and knights have different abilities, and they must be moved carefully across platforms to complete each level. But be careful—characters can only survive a limited number of flips, and platforms can't be flipped if they are occupied!

title: Checkers
description:
Immerse yourself in classic checkers on the go! 
Enjoy strategic moves, challenging AI, and hot-seat multiplayer fun in this classic checkers game!
Dive into the timeless fun of Checkers! Experience sleek design, smart AI opponent, and thrilling hot-seat multiplayer matches in this classic board game. Master strategy and make every move count!

title: Gas Station: Junkyard Tycoon
description: Build Your Dream Gas Station and Garage Tycoon Empire! Take charge in Gas Station Simulator Inc., the ultimate game for oil tycoon enthusiasts, idle games managers, and aspiring entrepreneurs! Manage, rebuild, and expand the gas station simulator, clean up your junkyard, and fix cars in this immersive and rewarding gas station simulator.

title: Obby: Gym Simulator, Escape
description:
Help Obby build up his muscles to escape from the castle!
Swing and get bigger!

The game has a rank system.
Defeat bosses, compete with other players for the first place in the ranking!

Spend cups on eggs, collect all the pets.
They will help you swing much faster.

It's up to you to press a barbell, carry weights or lift dumbbells.

title: Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Mini Games Puzzle Collection
description:
Mini Games: Puzzle Collection is an addictive collection of mini games, including 3 of the most popular puzzle games. You need to use limited wooden planks to build a bridge to help doge eat
bones on the other side of the river, draw lines to send donuts to doge. You can also experience the day of a stall owner, satisfying the needs of customers exactly. These fresh and interesting challenges require you to use your brain and solve them one by one through logical thinking.

title: Tricky Life
description:
Welcome to Tricky Life, the funniest brain test puzzle game ever made!
Here, logic meets laughter every level is designed to make you giggle, think twice, and smile when you finally find the answer.

title: Ball Craze Sort
description:
Ball Craze Sort is a fun, relaxing, and addictive puzzle game where your goal is to sort colorful balls into the correct order. What starts as a simple task quickly turns into a brain-teasing challenge as more colors and tubes are introduced.
Ball Craze Sort is the perfect game to unwind or mentally recharge. Whether you’re looking to relax for a few minutes or challenge your logic skills for hours, this game offers the ideal balance between fun and focus.

title: Capybara Jump
description: Bounce into a cute stacking challenge with Capybara Jump! Time your taps to leap as wooden blocks slide in from both sides, building a towering platform under your capybara. Land perfectly to chain combos, trigger sparkles, and push your score higher before a mistimed jump sends you tumbling down.

title: Flower Block
description: Dive into our unique COMBO gameplay, where you strategically place blocks to clear rows or columns. Watch as clearing multiple lines triggers exciting animations and earns you bonus points. Challenge your mind and plan your moves wisely to ace Flower Block!

title: Black Pink St.Patricks day Concert
description: Step into the glamorous world of Black Pink St. Patrick’s Day Concert, the ultimate dress-up game! Style your favorite Black Pink members with trendy outfits, accessories, and makeup to make them shine for their St. Patrick’s Day performance. With simple controls and endless creativity, this game is perfect for quick fun or long gaming sessions.

title: We Will Not Survive
description: Survive the apocalypse in We Will Not Survive, an idle tower defense game! Upgrade weapons, harvest resources, and fight relentless zombie waves to protect your base. Are you ready to defend and thrive?

title: Daring Jack
description:
Jack, an adventurer, was flying over the sea in his small aircraft. When he reached a jungle island, his aircraft's engine failed and he lost control. He escaped from the crashing aircraft, landed safely on the island, and now must find a boat to leave.

He knows of the old boathouse on the island but is uncertain how to reach it. Guide him through the jungle to the boathouse. Help him gather items for survival, focusing on securing food and shelter while navigating the challenging terrain.

title: Cat Escape
description: Play Cat Escape, the viral cat puzzle hide-and-seek game now free online! Sneak past guards, dodge traps, and guide your kitty to safety across hundreds of stealth levels. Unlock skins, collect coins, and outsmart enemies in this browser cat game loved worldwide. Want the full mobile experience? Discover more at CatEscapeTheGame.com
