title: Tic Tac Toe Merge
description:
Tic-Tac-Toe Merge is a revolutionary twist on the classic game! Unlike traditional tic-tac-toe, pieces have power levels from 1 to 3. Place higher-level pieces to capture your opponent's weaker ones!

MERGE TO DOMINATE
Combine two level-1 pieces to create level-2, and two level-2 to forge powerful level-3. Create chain reactions when 3+ same-level pieces align — they merge into an even stronger piece!

title: Beach Soccer
description: Immerse yourself in a fun-filled beach adventure where your goal is to aim and shoot the ball into the goal while collecting starfish for maximum points. With over 20 challenging levels, you'll need to think strategically to navigate obstacles like crabs and sandcastles. Enjoy a vibrant beach setting complete with golden sand, coconut trees, and a soothing soundtrack.

title: Rainbow Balls 2048
description: A game in the genre of 2048, where you can skilfully use game physics to achieve victory. The main task is to connect the balls and reach the number 2048. The game also features a booster, which makes passing the game more fun and easier.

title: Cannon Merge
description: Beat off waves of snow monsters, connect cannons to get more and more improved cannon models. Monsters are strong and there are a lot of them, they constantly attack. Upgrade the base and guns, defeat them all!

title: Stickman Mega Boss: Battles!
description: Battle hordes of Minecraft mobs! Buy awesome swords and helmets, or unbox them from cases. Take on mega-bosses, unlock different modes, and earn leaderboard points to become the best in this game!

title: Find It Fast
description: Discover the ultimate hidden object game! Test your observation skills by uncovering hidden items in fun, challenging levels. Relax and enjoy this scavenger hunt adventure with stunning puzzles. Focus on listed items, tap to reveal hidden objects, and race against time to unlock vibrant maps. Explore interactive scenes, solve puzzles, and prove yourself as the scavenger hunt master! Enjoy free gameplay, endless entertainment, and thrilling challenges. Play now and see what you can FIND!

title: Lava Jump
description: Lava Jump is a fast-paced parkour platformer set in a deadly lava-filled dungeon! Jump across moving blocks, bounce off boost pads, and ride shifting platforms to survive. Complete more than 25 levels, evade enemies, spikes and other deadly objects and escape from the lava dungeon alive. Collect coins and get new characters to use in your adventure.

title: Screw Puzzle Master
description: Pull out the nuts and bolts and release the woods. Get ready for a fluent and entertaining screw puzzle! It is time to do some brain practice. Many game levels, entertaining puzzles, and super power-ups await you!  Challenge a friend and complete chapters as fast as you can. Place the bolts as strategically as you can. Buy different skins and play in a different ambient.

title: Mahjong Cute Tiles
description: Enjoy a classic Mahjong game, now in another dimension! Rotate the board, explore fresh tile layouts and challenge your mind. Show off your skills and use powerful boosters like undo moves, tile shuffles, bombs and hints to help you advance faster.

title: Hole Eat Grow Attack
description:
Eat objects, and ammos, and attack other holes around. Two unique game modes, time attack and infinite modes are waiting for you. Let your hole battle begin in the arena against the other holes.

The game consists of two levels Time Attack and Infinite. There are more than 20 characters. You can play the game either in single-player mode or in 2 player mode. Pick your hole fighter and start the game. You can activate player 2 with keys. Make sure you avoid larger-hole enemies around.

title: Block Team Deathmatch
description: Block Team Deathmatch is a first-person shooting simulation game. All models are made of pixel blocks including scenes, characters, and weapons. We have 4v4 Team Mode, Individual Mode, and Sniper Mode for you to select. If I were you, I would play the Team Mode first for better equipment, then challenge the other 2 modes when the rank levels up. If you never played any shooting games, I recommend you buy an auto-rifle to fight at any distance. Keep calm and shoot first!

title: Moto Cabbie Simulator
description: Welcome to Moto Cabbie Simulator, where the thrill of the open road meets the fast-paced world of urban transportation! In this exhilarating and immersive gaming experience, players take on the role of a daring motorcycle taxi rider navigating the bustling streets of a vibrant city.

title: Color Water Puzzle
description:
Color Water Puzzle is a fun and addictive puzzle game! The goal is simple yet challenging: try to sort the colored water in the glasses until all colors are in the same glass.

It’s not just a game; it's a great way to relieve stress and exercise your logic. With vibrant colors and smooth pouring effects, this is the best choice to kill time and relax your mind.

Are you smart enough to solve all the levels? Download now and find out!

title: ASMR Makeover & Makeup Studio
description: Get ready to dive into the world of beauty and creativity! ASMR Makeup & Makeover Studio offers an incredible opportunity to give your virtual model a stunning makeover. This isn't just any makeover game — it's an immersive experience that combines relaxation and excitement through the power of ASMR!

title: Jinn Dash
description: Dive into a desert adventure in this arcade game! Similar to the classic Arkanoid, your mission is to break all the bricks using a magic carpet.

title: Belote 3in1
description:
Play 3 of the most popular card games with smart & powerful AI co-players, who won’t forget the game’s rules:
- French Belote – the original: a trick-taking game played by four players in two teams, using a 32-card deck, and featuring Ace-Ten cards. 
- Contrée – a variant of Belote with advanced bidding options.
- Coinche – a variant of Belote with even further advanced bidding options, declarations, and No Trumps & All Trump modes.

title: Girlfriend from Hell
description:
Girlfriend From Hell is an addictive and fun 2D arcade puzzle game. The main goal of the game is the girl's revenge on her lover. The heroine needs to find objects and use them to make her boyfriend's life hell.  
You need to collect various items to make a trap with them.

title: Nuts Bolts Screw Glass
description: "Nuts & Bolts: Screw Glass" is a creative puzzle game. In this meticulously designed mechanical world, you need to match different screws to their corresponding colored boxes. Every move requires careful consideration, as unmatched screws will fall into the groove at the bottom — once the groove is filled, the game is over.

title: Zindex
description:
You are in an epidemic-stricken zone. The streets are filled with hordes of hungry zombies, and the survivors have long since abandoned this place. Your only hope for rescue is to repair an abandoned radio tower and call for help.
Explore dangerous locations, scavenge houses, crates, and closets in search of valuable resources. Gather materials to craft weapons, tools, and essential items. Fight zombies in melee combat or use firearms—the choice is yours.

title: Dice Fusion
description: Dice Fusion is a casual game with puzzle content. The game is easy to understand and use the game mechanism, as well as highly strategic gameplay, colorful vision and with a leisurely background sound, to bring users visual and auditory dual enjoyment, so as to achieve the relaxation of the user's physical and mental needs.

title: Radical Rappelling
description:
Feel the rush and hold on tight as Radical Rappelling is back!

Join Rip and Roxy as you rappel down mountains at breakneck speed using your rapid reflexes.

Pull off death-defying tricks by ricocheting between launch pads, riding rainbows and rocketing over obstacles in the most redonkulous adventure ever.

Rack up coins and complete rockin’ missions to unlock sweet new gear for Rip and Roxy, the most fearless risk-takers on the planet.

title: Italian Brainrot Drag Merge Puzzle
description: A Revolutionary Jigsaw Experience. Each level, one image is randomly selected and split into 3×3, 4×4, 5×5, or 6×6 pieces, then completely shuffled. Your goal is simple: restore the picture by placing every piece in its correct position. But this is no ordinary jigsaw. When two neighboring pieces are placed correctly next to each other, they merge into a single movable cluster. Instead of slow, one-by-one placement, you can drag any piece or merged group onto another to instantly swap positions.

title: Oil Tanker Transport Truck
description: Let's go on to ride with an oil tanker transporter truck across all the continents like the Euro, Asia, and America oil transporter truck game has real features in the Euro and American cargo systems of the fuel truck.

title: Kick the Noobik 3D
description:
Smash, slice, blow up, incinerate, and unleash your creativity. Arm yourself with an endless arsenal: rockets, swords, machine guns, torture devices, and even a BIG BOOM. Welcome to Kick the Noobik 3D – more than just a game! Craving more kicks?

Even if you're usually calm, everyone needs to vent sometimes. Kick the Noobik 3D is the PERFECT WAY TO RELIEVE STRESS!

title: Block Cut Cleaner
description: An original block puzzle where the field is filled with triangle blocks! Pull out your shapes and place them on the field to clear at 100%. But be careful: each piece you place can create new blocks! Use smart boosters to turn the tide: refresh your inventory, remove three random triangles or place a "clean" square that doesn't leave blocks behind. Plan your strategy to clear the board completely!

title: Spaces Solitaire
description: Use spaces to arrange all cards in suit and in sequence from 2 to King. You can move a card to a space or empty spot if it is the same color and 1 higher in value than the card to the left of the space.

title: Body Care Simulator
description: ASMR Cleaning is a fun simulation game on yad.com. There are four sections: foot spa, manicure, lip care, and clean inside the ear. You will enter a quiet and comfortable environment and experience different care processes. Have fun!

title: IDLE Archeology
description:
Archaeological excavation simulator. Try to collect from the bones of a dinosaur!
Become the head of archaeological excavations.

title: Flight Pilot Airplane Games 24
description: In this Real Flight Pilot Airplane Games 24 you will experience the piloting of an aircraft. This free airplane game will let you involve in navigating the aircraft through a series of obstacles, such as sea, mountains, buildings, and other aircraft while avoiding crashes and collisions and maintaining the plane's height and speed. It would be best if you also had to manage the airplane fuel, speed, altitude, and other flying physics.

title: Happy Bubbles
description: Boom! Hear that pop? The bubbles are calling! This classic bubble shooter blends quick reflexes with clever strategy. Spin the Lucky Wheel for extra rewards, claim weekly bonus and dive into a bright, cute world that never runs out of fun.

title: Taxi Simulator 2024
description:
Are you prepared to play an awesome simulator? Taxi Simulator 2024 is an online game set in an open environment with objectives to help you improve your cab driving abilities. Pick up the passengers and drive them to their destination, following the directions and exploring all of the maps to locate the streets and addresses.

This game includes many game modes to keep you entertained; accomplish the stages in taxi or open mode, and freely explore the whole landscape.

title: Protect My Dog 3
description: Protect My Dog 3 is a fun casual puzzle game. The aim of the game is to protect our cute dog from bee attacks. For this, you must create a defensive drawing line at the levels. You should also protect your dog from lava, thorns and different environmental hazards. Fighting the Bees will continue for 100 Levels and things will get a little more difficult with each level.

title: Ancient Wars: Caesar
description: Ancient Wars: Caesar is an exciting strategy game in which you lead an army and fight for supremacy on the battlefield. The game takes you to the world of epic battles where tactics, planning and proper utilization of resources are important. Control various units, including warriors, archers and generals, to destroy enemy troops and destroy their base.

title: Sea Match
description: See Match is a challenging match-3 puzzle game. Connect 3 or more of the same fishes horizontally or diagonally. The more fishes you match, the higher your score! Keep an eye on the time. You will fail to pass the level if you do not gather sufficient grids in time. The faster you complete the task, the more stars you earn! If you find yourself stuck, you can always use the special bonuses to help you.

title: Nesting Dolls
description: Embark on an exciting adventure with an addictive puzzle game that will challenge your mind and soothe your soul. Immerse yourself in a world of bright colours and intricate Russian matryoshka dolls as you complete tasks to clear the field and become a true matryoshka doll master.

title: Grow Castle Defence
description: It's a completely different castle defense game. Strengthen your soldiers and prepare them for battle. Upgrade your archers for a better defense. Fight different enemies by leveling up. Each level adds to the excitement of the game. Watch as the enemies of the pal world evolve as you face them. Earn coins for each enemy and grow stronger.

title: Hoop Rivals
description: Hoop Rivals flips the court on its head! In this fast-paced arcade battler, you are the hoop—spinning, bouncing, and racing to catch the ball before your rivals do. Face off against up to 5 players in chaotic, high-flying matches where only the fastest hoop wins!

title: Infantry Attack Battle 3D FPS
description: Soldier! Stop playing the escape game! The third world war is here, and the mission is waiting for you! The enemy is attacking our country, and we count on you to protect it, so grab your weapon and prepare to fight! Easy control to aim and shoot the enemy, finish each task to win the ultimate victory!

title: Avenger Guard
description: Dark forces have destroyed your homeland—rise as the Avenger Guard! Merge heroes to unlock power, fortify defenses, and take vengeance. Lead your legendary squad to repel waves of enemies, upgrade through fusion, and reclaim what’s yours. Will you be the last line of defense?

title: Snow Rush 3D
description:
Snow Rush 3D is a fun sledding game that tests speed and reflexes for winter sports enthusiasts, playable in both 1 and 2 players! Try to reach the longest distance by overcoming obstacles and ramps on a challenging snow-covered track, or challenge your friend!

Snowmen, obstacles and tricky turns await you along the way. How far can you go and how many gifts can you collect?
